titles_read.author: Kevin Fahy, John Freeland, Kevin Free, Andrew Simpson (eds)
titles_read.first_edition: Casuarina Press, Sydney, 2004, large quarto, about 362 pp, colour plates, limited to 2000 numbered copies with dust jacket. Dealers list only this edition; I found no sign of a later printing.
titles_read.reason: Casuarina Press is the only publisher and the book was a single limited printing in 2004; the jacket looks original. Two other copies of this title were on Gowans recently (lots 442172, 443676, no sale price recorded).
titles_read.check_at_viewing: Check the limitation page for a number out of 2000, any signatures, and jacket and page condition. Number is price-irrelevant; a good clean copy is the whole game.

lots.lot_verdict: Genuine limited first printing but modest value; Gowans hammered $65 for a numbered copy in Oct 2025. Ceiling hammer about $65-80.

titles_read.title: Bert Stern / Marilyn Monroe: The Complete Last Sitting, 2571 photographs
titles_read.author: Bert Stern
titles_read.publisher_seen: Schirmer Art Books (jacket front, sealed in plastic)
titles_read.first_edition: The first edition is 1982 (Schirmer/Mosel, Munich; English The Last Sitting, William Morrow, New York, 1982). This jacket reads '2571 Photographs. Schirmer Art Books', which matches the 1992 Schirmer Art Books edition (ISBN 3888141915, 463-464 pp, 2571 images), not the 1982 first. Sellers call it a first of the Complete edition.

first_value_sold.venue: Mullock's, uncertain match to a 1992 copy
first_value_sold.note: search snippet said layout ambiguous, so treat as unconfirmed

titles_read.reason: Cover wording points to the 1992 Schirmer Art Books edition; the 1982 book is a different, smaller work. But it is the sought-after complete edition and sealed.
titles_read.check_at_viewing: Check the box or spine for 1992 or later year, and the ISBN. If it is 1992 first printing in English, it is the desirable edition. Do not open the seal; check the plastic for the copyright line.

lots.lot_verdict: Worth bidding: heavy, large-format book with dealer asking of US$450-600 (A$700-900+); no solid SOLD comps found, so hold a ceiling of roughly $200-300 hammer until a sold price is confirmed.
